correctness.rationale: For each nonzero coordinate vector x, its square vector is nonzero, so the uniform GL_n mean is one. The simultaneous fixed-vector probability for ordered independent x,y is exactly 1/[(q^n-1)(q^n-q)] precisely when their coordinatewise squares are independent. In odd characteristic a support-s vector has (q-1)2^(s-1) nonzero square-projectively colliding partners, of which q-1 are proportional; the binomial support sum yields ((q-1)/2)((2q-1)^n-2q^n+1). In even characteristic Frobenius preserves independence. Variance equals second factorial moment because mean is one. Formula strictness and asymptotic are proved; a standalone verifier directly exhausts ten parameter cases, including GF(4), GF(9), and n=4.
